purpose: Exact rollback sources for the three Edge Functions that carry the CL-13 Edge half and are NOT in the M0 Edge package (raziel-attention, wa-hatishbi, wa-uriel), read-only from the deployed versions on 12.11.2026. The other three CL-13 functions (wa-raziel, ai-analyze, number-researcher) are in docs/reviews/m0-security-stabilization-20261112/edge-rollback/manifest.json. No secrets and no personal data are stored here: every file comes from git history.
how_to_use: node scripts/m0-edge-rollback-assemble.mjs --manifest docs/reviews/cl13-personal-memory-20261112/edge-rollback-manifest.json <slug|all> <out-dir>  (needs the two source commits: git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 065aa022b9ecf1152c14aaf1be3460c7c8136e6c aa0f6bc82b8c94286374b1f51208037502994eab). The script rebuilds the deployed file layout and checks every SHA-256; it never deploys.
